vertical_acceptance: reply_to_peer({in_reply_to, content, meta?}) posts to /v1/replies with a per-call ULID Idempotency-Key reused on retry and stamps x-hangar-return-selector from the local agent-call registry when $TMUX_PANE is set
send_to_peer forwards thread_root and all_sessions and surfaces relay refusals (use_reply_verb hint verbatim); both tools return the two-part audience report
instructions.ts replaces only the 'passing to = the sender's handle and optionally in_reply_to' sentence with the reply verb; the six-point charter is byte-identical

switchboard persists its courier instance in config.json, calls POST /v1/grants/finalize before pasting, reports return_target_gone with reason in {not_registered, generation_stale, harness_changed, pid_dead, none_selector} and finalize_failed, and has no fallback to all panes
cli/send.ts always sends x-hangar-instance (courier instance in a pane, ~cli outside) and x-hangar-return-selector (<name>@<generation> or ~none)
corepack pnpm -F @hangar-bridge/peer-agent exec vitest run --coverage passes with lines >= 80%
